svg.title: Choosing and wiring an agent-operable web UI layer
svg.desc: Classify each route as content-first or interactive. Content routes stop at crawlable HTML, sitemap, and Schema.org JSON-LD. Light forms add declarative WebMCP attributes. Interactive apps feature-detect document.modelContext or wire a structured bridge such as UI SDK createAgent, then guard mutations with allow hooks and server authorization.
svg.text: Choosing and wiring an agent-operable web UI layer
